definitions.explanation: Anything out of the ordinary or wrong, used almost only in the negative: there is nothing wrong.

examples.japanese: ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{別状|べつじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: His life is not in danger.

examples.japanese: ⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{特|とく}に→特に：01260_tokuni⟧{別状|べつじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: The tests showed nothing particularly wrong.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運転手|うんてんしゅ}→運転手：01333_untenshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{軽|かる}い→軽い：00785_karui⟧⟦けが→けが：00787_kega⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{別状|べつじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧。
examples.english: The driver suffered minor injuries but is said to be in no danger.

notes:
Almost always in the set phrase ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{別状|べつじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (not life-threatening), a standard line in news reports of accidents. Also written {別条|べつじょう}, the spelling most newspapers use.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{別状|べつじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: not life-threatening
- {別状|べつじょう}なし: nothing wrong (written)
